Stock market news | Shriram Finance jumps on Sensex inclusion, potential $294 million outflows

Shriram Finance was added to the Sensex on 23 November 2026, prompting its shares to rise.

The change means Trent exits the index and analysts estimate possible $294 million outflows, affecting market composition.
